result.summary: The page is a food delivery home screen that is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a loading spinner stuck on the hero image of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card even though the image itself appears fully rendered, suggesting a stalled or orphaned loading state. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousels, bottom nav) look intact.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image in the 'Popular right now' section, while the underlying image is already fully rendered. This indicates a stuck/orphaned loading indicator that never dismissed, which looks broken and obscures part of the image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loading state is cleared once the image has loaded (e.g., hide the spinner on the image onLoad event) and add a timeout/fallback so the spinner cannot persist indefinitely.
